description: Is it safe to travel to a country, according to the UK Foreign Office? Returns the FCDO headline for one country: whether it advises against all or all-but-essential travel (to the whole country or to parts), the latest change and when it was made, recent change history and the sections available. Live from the GOV.UK Content API. Advice is written for British nationals; it does not give other governments' advice and does not replace reading the full warnings before booking. (cost: 1 credit)

country.description: string, required, country name, alternative name (city, island) or GOV.UK slug, e.g. "ukraine", "united-arab-emirates" (travel_advice_countries lists slugs)

name: travel_advice_country
